selector.rule: cognitive_os.experience_compilations whose task_run_id is one of the 150 enumerated execution.task_run_ids in sprint-21c3-w3-campaign.json
selector.why_a_selector_was_needed: The released C3 evidence counts the 60 correction manifests but does not enumerate them, and the evidence store holds 250 compilations spanning every wave.

pairing.source: experience_sources.source_revision on the coding_trajectory source of each compilation
pairing.note: The failed-to-corrected pairing is recorded in the C3 evidence itself, so D1 declares no pairing rule of its own.

legacy_status.reason: The manifests carry a legacy wall-clock created_at, for example 2026-07-30T06:10:21.675830Z, so recompilation cannot reproduce them byte for byte. Backlog section 0.3 requires this to be marked rather than repaired.

read_only_proof.method: raw SQL SELECT and file reads only; no application service was used, so no corpus, memory or experience access row was written

environment_change.why: src/cognitive_os/verification/factory.py registers the four logic verifiers only when find_spec("z3") succeeds; without it they stay unavailable and the wave W3b logic runs could not be verifier-backed.
environment_change.method: the single locked version installed with --no-deps, not a full uv sync
environment_change.why_not_a_full_sync: uv.lock pins sentence-transformers 5.6.0 while 5.6.1 is installed, and torch is a local +cpu build. A full sync would replace both and perturb the frozen MiniLM stack, which is release-frozen material.
environment_change.verifiers_available_after: 57 of 65, including logic.satisfiable, logic.contradiction, logic.implication and logic.equivalence
environment_change.regression_check: 466 passed, 2 skipped across tests/cognitive_os/verification, tests/contract/verifiers and tests/cognitive_os/domains

gate_contribution.condition_9: met for the historical half: 60 of 60 manifests resolve every required event and artifact without mutating legacy bytes
gate_contribution.condition_11: partially met: 60 of the required 80 pairs are frozen and source-bound. The remaining 20 fresh logic and mathematics pairs are wave W3b.
